originalTitle: Anthropogenic olivine-based direct air capture of CO2 at >10^9 tons CO2/year before 2050?
title: 橄榄石碳移除能否达到每年十亿吨量级？
Will olivine-based carbon removal exceed one billion tonnes per year?
rules: 原题要求人为增加的橄榄石路线 CO₂ 捕集量，在 2050 年前超过每年 10⁹ 吨。
The question requires human-induced olivine-based CO₂ capture above 10⁹ tonnes per year before 2050.
interpretation: 这是矿物风化相关市场，不是 MOF 市场；成交和参与者很少，展示原始数量，不把概率称为科学界共识。
This mineral-weathering contract is not a MOF market. Activity is thin; its probability is not described as scientific consensus.

summary: 预测 2050 年前人为橄榄石路线超过每年十亿吨 CO₂；只有两位参与者、两个采样点，无法支持细致走势判断。
This asks about >1 Gt CO₂/year from human-enhanced olivine before 2050. Two participants and two observations cannot support a detailed trend.
checklist: 核查是年度净大气移除量，而非矿物投放量或累计量。
Check annual net atmospheric removal, not mineral deployment or cumulative totals.
核算溶解、空气—海洋交换、过程排放和额外性。
Account for dissolution, air–sea exchange, process emissions and additionality.
同时查生态风险与监测数据；理论潜力不代表实际规模。
Review ecology and monitoring alongside scale; theoretical potential is not deployment.

stage: 现场试验 → 监测核证 → 可复制净移除
Field pilot → MRV → repeatable net removal
impact: Vesta 的沿岸试验直接关联橄榄石溶解和监测问题；工程化能否复制，要看现场数据与净移除核证。Svante 的过滤器工厂属于另一条捕集路线，仅用来说明“制造能力”与“已完成移除量”为什么要分开。

Vesta’s pilots address olivine dissolution and monitoring. Repeatable deployment needs field results and verified net removal. Svante is a different capture pathway, included to distinguish manufacturing capacity from realized removal.
gap: 这些资料没有建立每年十亿吨的人为橄榄石净移除。原题只有两个采样点，无法据价格曲线分析某次企业消息的反应。
These sources do not establish annual gigatonne removal by human-enhanced olivine. Two observations cannot support a market-response analysis of a corporate announcement.

title: 矿物溶解与净大气碳移除，口径不同
Dissolved mineral and net atmospheric removal are different quantities
principle: 橄榄石风化可向海水提供碱度，使其有能力吸收更多 CO₂。投放多少矿石、溶解多少矿石，以及最终多吸收了多少大气 CO₂，需要分别核算；磨矿、运输与过程排放也影响净值。

Olivine weathering can add alkalinity, increasing seawater’s capacity to absorb CO₂. Deployed mineral, dissolved mineral and additional atmospheric uptake are distinct quantities, with grinding, transport and process emissions affecting net removal.
example: 原题的 10⁹ 吨/年是年度规模门槛，不能用累计投放量或整个海洋增碱领域的理论潜力替代。NOAA 的短期实验提供了化学和生态线索，仍没有建立全球十亿吨级部署或长期安全结论。

The 10⁹-tonne/year threshold is an annual scale, not cumulative mineral deployment or the theoretical potential of all ocean alkalinity methods. NOAA’s short-term work informs chemistry and ecology without establishing gigatonne deployment or long-term safety.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
